# @codenhub/skills

> A curated collection of agent skills and an installer CLI that copies selected skills into local or global harness folders without manually copying directories.

Requires Node.js 24 or newer. Run `pnpm dlx @codenhub/skills@latest` or
`npx @codenhub/skills@latest` in the target project for the wizard. Explicit
options support automation. There are no supported programmatic library imports.
Treat `skills/**` Markdown as shipped agent instructions rather than package
documentation. Updates merge directories, overwrite matching files, and keep
stale files. Review destructive cleanup and failure behavior before updating.

## Documentation

- [Documentation overview](docs/index.md): Canonical package documentation entrypoint.
- [Bundled skills](docs/skills.md): Choose workflows; learn skill format, quality rules, drafts, and versioning.
- [CLI installer](docs/cli.md): Modes, options, destinations, harness behavior, and destructive cleanup.
- [Security and failure behavior](docs/security-and-failures.md): Path constraints, partial writes, and exit behavior.

## Optional

- [Skill provenance](docs/provenance.md): Third-party origins, licenses, and notices for shipped assets.
